title: Qualification evidence
summary: NORM dev3 has live libnorm evidence for ASM, SSM, NACK repair, IPv6 multicast, descriptor readiness and explicit membership lifecycle, plus a later SocketProvider dev16 requalification.
invariants: Qualification runtime is ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and live libnorm 1.5.7; consumed public NRL C API declarations were checked against normApi.h blob 0caa5c34e72e5fecd42c373bf49b7433530065be whose header identifies 1.5.10.
IPv4 ASM, IPv4 SSM, descriptor readiness and exact 520000-byte receive passed.
The no-parity 10 percent loss forcing case passed through NORM repair.
IPv6 multicast passed on an interface with an actual ff00::/8 route; the qualification does not claim every network supports multicast, SSM or IPv6.
On 2026-10-10 the same NORM dev3 archive passed live against SocketProvider dev16, SHA-256 fe2fa086bd4f1e072b8d455e6adb4475482b8db6a35118329f6b3f6e6253c8c2.
